title: My Firsts "Games"
author: East-Dragonfruit9376
selftext:
I've always been intrigued by game development, but programming was really tough for me. I can read code pretty well and put together a script here and there for specific tasks, but I've always admired those of you who know how to design and build a game from scratch.

Now, with AI, I can start bringing to life those little ideas that pop into my head "in my old age." And the best part isn't just seeing them work: it’s trying to understand how they’re built under the hood, tweaking the physics, adjusting mechanics, and seeing what happens.

I still have a ton to learn, but I’m finally getting to enjoy something that has always caught my eye.

Anyway, here are my first two creations xDDD
